verdict.rationale: Unity serves llms.txt files on unity.com, on docs.unity.com (a site-wide '# Unity Documentation' index), and in its CLI docs section, and Services API spec pages have raw markdown mirrors. However, the core engine documentation at docs.unity3d.com has no llms.txt (HTTP 404) and no .md mirrors, so agents cannot easily consume the main Manual. Missing for 10: llms.txt for the docs.unity3d.com engine Manual and scripting docs, markdown mirrors of Manual pages, independent hands-on corroboration of agent use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: docs.unity.com also serves a site-wide llms.txt index ('# Unity Documentation').
Its docs section serves its own llms.txt ('# Unity command-line interface (CLI)').
each spec page carrying a "Download OpenAPI specification" control and a raw markdown mirror embedding the full OpenAPI 3.0.0 JSON
